name: Capital Improvement Plan
description: 10-year School Board plan funding major facility investments largely through County GO bonds
routing_rule: Large building-system projects the School Board lists in the adopted CIP (Oakridge is here)
policy_citation: Va. Code § 15.2-2640 (bond referendum request); adopted FY2027-36 CIP

name: Major Construction/Minor Maintenance
description: Replacement of major building components (HVAC, roofs, floors, cafeterias) too large for the operating maintenance budget and not listed as a CIP project; funded annually in the Capital Projects Fund, $3.0M one-time in FY27
routing_rule: Smaller facility work not listed as a CIP project; no public dollar cutoff vs the CIP
policy_citation: APS Policy F-5.7 Capital and Maintenance Program and PIP F-5.7 (revisions adopted Aug 13, 2026 under consent; the revised PIP removed the MC/MM committee)

name: Private gift / external funding
description: Donations or privately funded building/grounds improvements reviewed under D-15
routing_rule: Any private money for a facility improvement; approver depends on project size
policy_citation: APS Policy D-15 External Funding (2025 draft text)
